field_docs.default_mode: Time of day used when a mission does not set one (missions pick 'day' or 'night')
field_docs.modes: Per mode ('day' and 'night' are required): display_name; sight_range_multiplier: multiplies every soldier's sight range; zombie_sight_multiplier: multiplies zombie sight range; roaming_multiplier: multiplies the difficulty's roaming_count; ambient_color/ambient_energy/background_color/sun_energy: lighting (colours RGB or RGBA 0..1)
